content: We implement and train some off-the-shelf RC models, including r-net BIBREF5 and AoA BIBREF6 , which are the leading models on SQuAD leaderboard. In our initial experiments, these models take fact description as passage and plea as query. Further, Law articles are added to the fact description as a part of the reading materials, which is a simple way to consider them as well.
